function execAsync(command) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const [bin, ...args] = command.split(' ');
        let proc = spawn(bin, args, { stdio: 'pipe', detached: true });

        // Wait for process to exit
        proc.on('exit', (code) => {
            if (code !== 0) {
                resolve({ stdout: '', stderr: `Process exited with code ${code}` });
            } else {
                reject(new Error(`Command not found or failed: ${command}`));
            }
        });

        let output = '';
        proc.stdout.on('data', (data) => { output += data; });
        proc.stderr.on('data', (data) => { 
            console.error(data);
            if (!output.includes('python3')) {
                reject(new Error(`Process not found: ${command}`));
            }
        });

        proc.stdin.end();
    });
